actions.description:
Frequency Three times per day

Effect The wendigo unleashes a forlorn howl that can be heard up to 1 mile away. Any creature that hears the howl must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:38] save or be Frightened 1. Any creature that critically fails and is within 120 feet of the wendigo is instead Frightened 3, and is also fleeing for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} (or until it's no longer frightened, whichever comes first).

A creature frightened by a wendigo's howl still naturally recovers from its fright but can't reduce it below frightened 1 in this way until 1 hour has passed or magic is used.

Whether it succeeds or fails its save, a creature is then temporarily immune to that wendigo's Howl for 24 hours.
actions.name: Howl

actions.description:
Trigger The wendigo casts Migration while it has Grabbed a foe.

Effect The wendigo attempts to turn the grabbed creature into wind and carry it along as part of the action. If the target succeeds at a @Check[will|dc:38] save, it prevents itself from being transformed; in this case, the wendigo still transforms, automatically releasing the victim.

A creature forced to Ride the Wind along with the wendigo is exposed to wendigo torment. The target can attempt a new Will save each round to return to normal, though it immediately becomes corporeal and begins falling if it succeeds.
actions.name: Ride the Wind
actions.trigger: The wendigo casts Migration while it has Grabbed a foe.

actions.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

actions.description: A target that fails its save against the wendigo's Nightmare is exposed to wendigo torment.
actions.name: Dream Haunting

actions.description: Heatsight is a precise sense that sees heat signatures.
actions.name: Heatsight 60 feet

actions.description:
A creature affected by wendigo torment can't recover beyond stage 1 until it has been restored to full HP.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:38]

Stage 1 Stupefied 4 (1 day)

Stage 2 As stage 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 The creature searches for an individual of its own ancestry to kill and devour. It then becomes affected by Migration and sprints into the sky so fast that its feet burn away into jagged stumps. As the creature wind walks into the sky, it is replaced by a new wendigo over [[/br 2d6 #minutes]]{2d6 minutes}.

Wish, similar magic, or a 9th-rank Resurrect ritual can return the victim to life. The new wendigo remains even if the victim is resurrected.
actions.name: Wendigo Torment

name: Wendigo
publicNotes: Wendigos are incarnations of the fears of starvation, loneliness, and fatal exposure to cold weather. They haunt the frozen expanses of the world.
